concept: Kuasa dua sebagai susunan segi empat sama unit
description: A grid of n×n unit cells rendered as a filled square, illustrating that n² equals the area of a square with side n.

concept: Pemfaktoran perdana untuk menentukan kuasa dua / kuasa tiga sempurna
description: A branching factor tree that breaks a number down to its prime factors, showing paired or tripled groups to identify perfect squares or cubes.

concept: Kuasa tiga sebagai isi padu kubus unit
description: An isometric drawing of an n×n×n stack of unit cubes, illustrating that n³ equals the volume of a cube with edge length n.

concept: Menganggar punca kuasa dua atau punca kuasa tiga dengan meletakkan nombor di antara dua nilai sempurna berturutan
description: A horizontal bracket diagram showing a value sandwiched between two perfect squares (or cubes) with their roots labelled, helping students estimate the root by bounding.

concept: Generalisasi pendaraban punca kuasa dua: √a × √a = a dan √a × √b = √(ab)
description: A visual pairing of two root expressions with an equals sign, showing √a × √a collapsing to a, or √a × √b combining into √(ab).
